topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Group code of conduct with annual acknowledgment; sanctions procedure applies to DC and 3PL staff
evidence: EV-099 (Acknowledgment records (DC-1 and DC-3 sample)); EV-032 (sanctions log)

control_description: Board risk committee oversees cyber and food safety risk quarterly; board audit committee oversees internal audit
Group CISO and division security and compliance leads with reporting lines in POL-01; 3PL services director owns customer commitments
gap: The 3PL services director's security duties are not written down, and the Food Distribution standards had no owner until 2026 (POAM-016)
remediation: Add 3PL security responsibilities to the Food Distribution supplement; confirm the standards owner

control_description: Background checks; annual awareness training; role training for portal developers and DC automation technicians
Accountability through POL-01 roles, division risk acceptance limits, and the sanctions procedure
Asset inventories from cloud tooling, the WMS, and SYS-G5 passive monitoring at DC-1 and DC-3
control_owner: Food Distribution security and compliance lead
gap: No inheritance matrix showing which 3PL controls are met by group common controls (POAM-017); interfaces between SYS-D3, the WMS, and SYS-G6 not listed as system components
remediation: Build the Food Distribution inheritance matrix; list every SYS-D3 interface

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Group policies published and acknowledged annually
gap: DC staff still work from the 2023 Food Distribution standards, which conflict with group policy (POAM-016; FD-007)
remediation: Re-issue the Food Distribution supplement and retire the 2023 standards

control_description: 3PL service agreements; customer security contact; incident notice within 72 hours of discovery (P08 matrix)
gap: No system description; service commitments differ across about 60 agreements written on four contract versions; complementary user entity controls never stated to customers
remediation: Write the system description and one set of service commitments; send a customer responsibilities letter

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives and risk tolerance in POL-01 and the P01 method; 3PL service levels in the BIA (BP-D04)
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis with a Food Distribution register that rolls up to the group register
control_owner: Food Distribution security and compliance lead

control_description: Fraud risk in the register: payment redirection (FD-010) and inventory manipulation to hide theft (FD-018)
Significant changes (new 3PL customers, portal features, DC automation changes) assessed in the risk analysis
control_owner: Food Distribution security and compliance lead
gap: Portal feature changes and new customer onboarding are not risk-assessed before release
remediation: Adopt the group change gate for SYS-D3 and customer onboarding

control_description: Group internal audit assesses common controls once and samples division controls (P07)
gap: The 2026 Food Distribution sample covered governance, backups, and log retention only; SYS-D3 application controls were not tested
remediation: Add SYS-D3 authorization and processing controls to the 2027 assessment plan

control_description: Deficiencies tracked in the group POA&M and reported to the board risk committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from SP 800-53 and the group common control catalog against P01 risks
General IT controls through SYS-G1 to SYS-G3 (identity, SOC, cloud guardrails)
evidence: EV-007 (Common control catalog); P07 common control results

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Group policies and the Food Distribution supplement
control_owner: Food Distribution security and compliance lead
gap: DC security procedures last reviewed in 2023 (P07 PL-1 finding; POAM-016)
remediation: Rewrite DC and 3PL operating procedures under the group policies

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Workforce SSO and MFA (SYS-G1); portal users authenticate with MFA; per-customer row-level security; encryption at rest
evidence: EV-008 (Identity configuration); EV-069 (portal authentication settings); EV-069 (database configuration)

control_description: Workforce access from HR events; customer administrators request portal users through the 3PL service desk
evidence: EV-099 (Access request sample (25 workforce, 25 portal users))
gap: Customer user provisioning and removal is a customer duty in practice but is not written as a complementary user entity control; 7 of 25 sampled portal users had left their companies
remediation: Document the customer duty; quarterly portal user confirmation by each customer

control_description: Quarterly access certification for workforce users; PAM for administrators
gap: Service accounts used by the WMS and DC automation integrations are among the 34 privileged directory service accounts outside PAM (POAM-012)
remediation: Bring the service accounts into PAM with rotated credentials

control_description: Badge access and CCTV at DC-1 and DC-3; provider facilities inherited (carved out)
Provider media sanitization; device disposal through the group IT asset disposal process

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Web application firewall and DDoS protection on SYS-D3; SYS-G5 gateway for vendor access at DC-1 and DC-3
gap: DC automation servers at DC-1 and DC-3 are joined to the corporate directory domain, so a domain compromise reaches automated freezer storage (GR-01)
remediation: Move DC automation to the OT domain behind the OT DMZ

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for portal traffic; encrypted EDI transport
evidence: EV-018 (TLS scan results); EV-069 (EDI partner list)
gap: EDI partner credentials are rarely rotated (FD-005)
remediation: Rotate EDI credentials yearly and on partner staff changes

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all servers and endpoints, including cloud hosts and DC automation Windows servers

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Weekly vulnerability scans; cloud guardrail drift reports; code scanning in the SYS-D3 pipeline
gap: Authorization tests that keep one brand from seeing another brand's data run only at major releases (FD-004)
remediation: Automated authorization regression tests on every release

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: 24x7 group SOC monitoring of cloud, identity, and SYS-G5 data
evidence: EV-011 (SOC coverage map); EV-011 (SIEM data source list)
gap: WMS and DC automation logs kept 30 days (POAM-019); cold-chain alerts and alert-delivery failures not sent to the SOC (POAM-010)
remediation: Keep logs 12 months; forward SYS-G6 alert and delivery events to the SIEM

control_description: SOC triage and severity rating with division liaisons
Group IR plan; P08 runbook with a 3PL customer notice row (72 hours from discovery)
gap: The cross-division notification matrix, including 3PL notices, has never been exercised (POAM-011)
remediation: Include a 3PL customer notice in the cross-division tabletop

control_description: SYS-D3 data restored from the provider B immutable vault (P07 test passed)
evidence: P07 CP-9 restore test; EV-020 (recovery runbook)
gap: DC automation server backups sit on domain-joined storage and have never been restore-tested (POAM-018)
remediation: Offline backups and a restore test at DC-1 and DC-3

control_description: Pull requests with peer review; change board for production releases of SYS-D3
BIA for the 3PL service (BP-D04: MTD 24 h, RTO 12 h, RPO 1 h); hurricane plan for DC-1; cyber insurance
evidence: P05 BIA; EV-062 (DC-1 hurricane plan); EV-035 (insurance policy)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Tiered vendor program; annual SOC 2 review for the WMS vendor; cold-chain vendor report reviewed 2026-08-31 (vendor-soc2-review.csv)
gap: The cold-chain vendor review found two complementary user entity controls not operating (gateways on general DC networks; single alert integration server), and the vendor contract lacks a 24-hour incident notice (POAM-006)
remediation: Close the two controls; add the notice term at renewal

control_description: Capacity monitoring and autoscaling for SYS-D3 on provider A
Multi-zone deployment; immutable backups in provider B; DR replicas; DC-1 and DC-3 generators
evidence: EV-069 (Architecture); EV-020 (backup reports); EV-062 (generator test logs)
gap: Temperature history in SYS-D3 depends on the single cold-chain alert integration server, which has no tested failover (POAM-005)
remediation: Active-active alert integration with a failover test

control_description: Recovery plan testing
gap: SYS-D3 has never been failed over to its provider B replica as a whole system; only data restores were tested
remediation: Full failover test before the observation period

control_description: Processing commitments for inventory, orders, and temperature history
gap: The meaning of the temperature history (sensor interval, delay to the portal, how gaps are shown) is not defined for customers
remediation: Publish processing specifications in the system description

control_description: EDI messages validated against schema; receiving scans checked against advance ship notices
evidence: EV-099 (EDI error reports); EV-099 (receiving exception logs)

control_description: WMS inventory processing with daily reconciliation and weekly cycle counts in 3PL rooms
Inventory, order, and temperature history reports in the portal
gap: Temperature reports do not mark readings that were backfilled from gateway buffers or missing, so a customer cannot tell a quiet period from a gap
remediation: Flag backfilled and missing readings in reports and exports

control_description: Temperature history kept append-only per customer (POL-04 4.5); retained for the agreement term plus 2 years
